chunks: He had no body to help him other than God, nor was he able to save himself.

key_terms.فِئَةٌ: A body, group, or faction of helpers
key_terms.مُنتَصِرًا: Able to save himself / Victorious by his own power

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God has no helpers or assistants?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Kahf, this verse highlights Allah's absolute self-sufficiency (Al-Ghani) to contrast with the polytheists' reliance on false deities, reinforcing the core doctrine of Tawhid. Shia exegetes often view this as a foundational proof for the divine attribute of being free from any need (Al-Faqir ila ghayrihi), establishing that all creation is entirely dependent on Him while He remains independent of all creation.
